Regarding the company’s performance and returns to shareholders, Rich Templeton, TI’s chairman, president and CEO, made the following comments: • “Revenue decreased 11% from the same quarter a year ago, as most markets weakened further.
• “In our core businesses, Analog revenue declined 8% and Embedded Processing declined 19% from the same quarter a year ago.

• “TI’s fourth quarter outlook is for revenue in the range of $3.07 billion to $3.33 billion, and earnings per share between $0.91 and $1.09, which includes an estimated $5 million discrete tax benefit.
